summary.value: Popover component, used to display content in a popover over an element.

example.value:
<Popover.TriggerContext>
  <Popover.Trigger>Open Popover</Popover.Trigger>
  <Popover>
    Content
  </Popover>
</Popover.TriggerContext>

@example without TriggerContext
<Button popovertarget="my-popover">Open Popover</Button>
<Popover id="my-popover">
  Content
</Popover>

a11y.method: drafted from the docs page, quote-verified, human-reviewed 2026-08-11 (batch 2: agent first-pass, ratified)

value.rule: Popover has built-in accessibility support for open/closed states and keyboard navigation via the native Popover API
value.quote: There is built-in accessibility in the Popover API (mozilla.org) for open and closed states and for keyboard navigation.

value.rule: Enter or Space opens or closes the popover
value.quote: Enter or Space opens or closes

relations.method: drafted from the docs page, quote-verified, human-reviewed 2026-08-11 (batch 2: agent first-pass, ratified)

value.note: Popover should be used instead of tooltip when the explanation needs more space than a short tooltip provides, e.g. definitions or detailed instructions
value.quote: you need to provide additional explanations that require more space than a short tooltip , such as definitions or detailed instructions

value.note: Avoid popover to describe a symbol or keyboard shortcut; use tooltip instead
value.quote: you need to describe a symbol or keyboard shortcut; use tooltip instead

value.note: Avoid popover when the purpose is navigation or choosing between options; use dropdown instead
value.quote: the purpose is navigation or choosing between options; use dropdown instead

value.note: Popover can be used as an extended solution when tooltip is not sufficient for the content
value.quote: It can be used as an extended solution when a tooltip is not sufficient.

composition.method: drafted from the docs page, quote-verified, human-reviewed 2026-08-11 (batch 2: agent first-pass, ratified)

value.rule: Popover is opened through an intentional user click and may contain text, links and simple form elements
value.quote: Popover is opened through an intentional user click and may contain text, links and simple form elements.

value.rule: Popover content should be short, relevant, and not critical for completing the task
value.quote: The content should be short, relevant, and not critical for completing the task.

value.rule: Popover may contain buttons and other interactive elements
value.quote: Popover may contain buttons and other interactive elements.

value.rule: Popover can be used inline within text, marked with a dotted underline, e.g. to explain a term
value.quote: You can use popover inline within text, marked with a dotted underline, for example when explaining a term.

value.rule: Popover displays more detailed or interactive supplementary information without taking the user out of context
value.quote: Popover is used to display more detailed or interactive supplementary information without taking the user out of context.

value.rule: Popover placement is automatic and stays within the visible browser area
value.quote: Popover can be placed as needed, and will automatically stay within the visible browser area.

value.rule: Automatic placement behaviour can be disabled using autoPlacement
value.quote: This behaviour can be disabled using autoPlacement .

value.rule: Avoid long texts and complex explanations in a popover; link to another page for more detailed information instead
value.quote: Avoid long texts and complex explanations. In some cases, it may be better to link to another page with more detailed information on the topic.
